_note: Manual v1 (2026-10-15) is the current Infant and Child Personal Care (Ages 0-5) Program Manual for Category 2. The house DOI suffix hmtc.manual.infant-and-child-personal-care is reserved for deposit. cert_doi stays empty until that deposit. Method edition is at /program/method.

versions.label: Manual v1
versions.summary: First Category 2 Program Manual. Sixteen live standards. Numeric ceilings are the values on those standards. Species with no separate number are capped at the parent total and tested on the program retest schedule. Metal safety only.
